one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 网页聊天中展示可缩放的 HTML 页面块，并可选取画布元素。
one_liner.en: Render zoomable HTML page blocks in DSH web chat and pick elements from the canvas.

local: Uses the DSH home directory for ui-block files; DSH_HOME overrides ~/.dsh.
The PNG preview tool requires the app web server, connection and attachment services, plus Microsoft Edge on Windows.

config_items.name: DSH_HOME
config_items.description: Base directory for saved ui-block files.

completeness.reason: Host tools create and read named blocks; the client renders references and supports canvas controls and element selection.

code.reason: The host separates file history, routes and tools; the client has dedicated render, interaction and picker paths.

docs.reason: README explains the current reference syntax, rendering controls and element-picking workflow.

maintenance.reason: Five commits are recorded, with the latest push within 30 days of this analysis.

tests.reason: A host self-check documents assertions, but the extracted facts report no recognized test files or CI.

quality.notes: Quality reflects the lite source sample; promotion routing did not apply.
